trials.title: 52 Week Study + 24-Month Long-Term Extension of Safety, PK, & Efficacy of XYOSTED® for Testosterone Replacement in Male Adolescents With Hypogonadism

primaryOutcomes.measure: Increase in testosterone, as evaluated using PK parameters

reasons: one of only 1 trials at this company

signals.text: Primary completion pushed out 5 months vs original registration (Nov 2024): Oct 2027 to Mar 2028 (1 move on record)
signals.read: Moderate delay. One slip is common; repeated slips are the signal.

trials.commentary: Ph 3, open-label. Targeting 100 patients. Started Mar 2025 (planned Jan 2025), primary completion Mar 2028 vs Oct 2027 at registration (+5 mo, 1 moves). Recruiting opened Feb 2025.
